benefit.en: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after attaining 60 years of age for unorganised workers.
benefit.te: అసంఘటిత కార్మికులకు 60 ఏళ్ల తర్వాత నెలకు రూ. 3,000 ఖచ్చితమైన పింఛను.

explain.en: Age must be between 18 and 40 years.

rules.source_clause: Unorganised workers between the entry age of 18 and 40 years are eligible.

explain.en: Monthly income must be at most Rs. 15,000.

rules.source_clause: Monthly income should not exceed Rs. 15,000/- per month.

explain.en: Must not be enrolled in EPFO, ESIC or NPS.
explain.te: EPFO, ESIC లేదా NPS లో నమోదు కాకూడదు.

rules.source_clause: Should not be engaged in organised sector (EPFO/ESIC/NPS) or an income taxpayer.

apply_steps.en: Visit Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and Savings Bank account passbook.
apply_steps.te: ఆధార్ మరియు సేవింగ్స్ బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్‌తో CSC కేంద్రానికి వెళ్లండి.
